description:
Sheet S-716, City of Pasadena Public Works and Transportation Department standard plan, revision 1, units DUAL (metric with US customary in parentheses), sheet 1 of 1, dated 7-23-01. It has two isometric details, a U-channel post extension on the left and a strap mounting on an existing street light or other pole on the right.

U-channel post extension: An existing U-channel post is shown with a short U-channel post section lapped onto it, with a sign mounted on the face of the post. The added section is 1.0 m (3') or 1.2 m (4') long, as specified, and its lower end overlaps the existing post by a minimum of 0.3 m (1'), with overlap as needed for sign height. Bolt holes in the lapped section are spaced at 205 mm (8") minimum between the bolts that join the two posts. Each connection uses a galvanized steel 8 mm (5/16") square head bolt with square washer (the label also shows square nut). The sign is held off the post by a 5 mm (1/8") spacer with fiber washer, 2 each sign, and is attached with galvanized steel 8 mm (5/16") button head bolts and square nuts. Labels: SIGN, EXISTING U-CHANNEL POST. The detail is titled U-CHANNEL POST EXTENSION.

Strap mounting, existing street light or other pole: An isometric view of a round pole with a sign mounted to it using two strapped-on brackets, one near the top and one near the bottom of the sign. Each bracket is a galvanized steel strapped-on bracket with an 8 mm (5/16") tapped hole, a stainless steel strap, and a neoprene washer. The strap is a 16 mm x 0.75 mm (5/8" x 0.03") stainless steel strap with a buckle. A bolt with round washer, shown on a dashed line, passes through the sign into each bracket. Label: SIGN. The detail is titled STRAP MOUNTING, EXISTING STREET LIGHT OR OTHER POLE.

Note at bottom left: clearance from the ground to the bottom of the lowest sign is 2.1 m (7').
notes:
Note: Clearance from the ground to the bottom of the lowest sign shall be 2.1 m (7').

Callouts: Section as specified 1.0 m (3') or 1.2 m (4'). 205 mm (8") minimum (MIN.). 0.3 m (1') MIN. overlap as needed for sign height. 5 mm (1/8") spacer with fiber washer, 2 each (EA.) sign. Galvanized steel 8 mm (5/16") button head bolt and square nut. Galvanized steel 8 mm (5/16") square head bolt, square washer. Galvanized steel strapped-on bracket with 8 mm (5/16") tapped hole, stainless steel bracket, and neoprene washer. 16 mm x 0.75 mm (5/8" x 0.03") stainless steel strap.
title: Post Extension and Sign Mounting
summary: Pasadena standard plan S-716 shows how to extend an existing U-channel sign post with a lapped section and how to strap-mount a sign to an existing street light or other pole. Hardware is galvanized steel bolts, a 5 mm spacer with fiber washer, and a stainless steel strap with neoprene-washer bracket. Clearance from the ground to the bottom of the lowest sign must be 2.1 m (7 ft).

description:
Sheet S-717, City of Pasadena Public Works and Transportation Department standard plan, revision 1, units DUAL, sheet 1 of 1, dated 7-23-01. One main elevation with an enlarged detail and Section A-A.

Elevation: A 760 mm (2'-6") high intensity R1R STOP sign (octagon) is mounted on a galvanized 65 mm (2 1/2") O.D. square tube (12 gauge), 3.0 m (10') long, ASTM-A446. The tube top extends 50 mm (2") above the top of the sign. Two rivet points are shown on the post centerline, one near the top and one near the bottom of the sign, each located 75 mm (3") from the sign edge. The bottom of the sign is 2.1 m (7') above the ground line. The post slides into a galvanized 75 mm (3") O.D. square anchor tube [wall thickness 5 mm (3/16")], 610 mm (24") long, ASTM-A500 Grade B. A 1.0 m (3') dimension runs horizontally from the post to the back of the adjacent curb and sidewalk shown at left. The curb section drawn at left shows a depth of 560 mm (1'-10") below grade, with a 50 mm (2") dimension at the base of the sidewalk. Note 1 marks the surface at the post, with a sloped concrete sidewalk edge.

Ground detail: The anchor tube is set in a concrete-filled hole. The hole is 305 mm (12") minimum to 455 mm (18") maximum wide, surrounded by tamped backfill (typical). Concrete (note 2) fills the hole. The anchor tube extends 510 mm (20") minimum to 610 mm (24") maximum below grade and its end is plugged to exclude concrete. A 100 mm (4") dimension shows the top of the anchor tube above grade, with a SLOPE symbol on the sidewalk.

Enlarged detail (circle): The sign post (cut away to show a wavy section) enters the top of the anchor tube. The post projects 25 mm (1") above the top of the anchor tube in the drawn view. Two holes are on adjacent faces of the anchor tube, 50 mm (2") below its top, and the anchor tube is shown with a 150 mm (6") dimension. Label: 11 mm (7/16") dia. hole in each tube for 9.5 mm (3/8") drive rivet.

Section A-A: A plan cut through the sign and post showing the square tube wall with a flat sign face against it, joined by an 11 mm (7/16") hole with a 9.5 mm (3/8") rivet.
notes:
Notes:
1. Consolidated backfill or concrete sidewalk, slope to drain.
2. Concrete may be premixed, sacked concrete or field proportioned cement and aggregate with water added and mixing occurring on the job site. 2% calcium chloride (by weight of cement) may be added to produce a quickset concrete. Concrete shall comply with "Standard Specifications for Public Works Construction," latest edition.

Callouts: 760 mm (30") high intensity R1R. 11 mm (7/16") hole, 9.5 mm (3/8") rivet. Galvanized 65 mm (2 1/2") O.D. square tube (12 gauge), 3.0 m (10') long, ASTM-A446. Galvanized 75 mm (3") O.D. square anchor tube [wall thickness 5 mm (3/16")], 610 mm (24") long, ASTM-A500 Grade B. 11 mm (7/16") dia. hole in each tube for 9.5 mm (3/8") drive rivet. Plug end of anchor tube to exclude concrete. Tamped backfill (typical).
title: STOP Sign and Post Replacement
summary: Pasadena standard plan S-717 shows replacement of a 760 mm (30 in) R1R STOP sign on a 3.0 m (10 ft) galvanized square tube post that slips into a 610 mm (24 in) anchor tube set in a concrete-filled hole. The sign bottom is 2.1 m (7 ft) above grade and the tubes are joined with 9.5 mm (3/8 in) drive rivets. Two notes cover backfill or sidewalk at the surface and concrete requirements.

description:
Sheet S-718, City of Pasadena Public Works and Transportation Department standard plan, revision 1, units DUAL, sheet 1 of 1, dated 7-23-01. Two isometric details: the STOP sign post extension at left and the street name signs mounted on it at right.

Stop sign post extension (for street name signs): A 57 mm (2 1/4") O.D. square steel tube extension, wall thickness of 12 gauge [3 mm (0.118")], galvanized, is telescoped into the top of the existing STOP sign post. Dimensions: the extension is 610 mm (24") long overall, with 460 mm (18") above the post top and 150 mm (6") inside the post. A 25 mm (1") dimension is shown at the top of the existing post. Rivet holes are spaced 100 mm (4") apart vertically on the post, with a further (4") spacing shown below, and the existing post is drawn with a 610 mm (24") dimension at its lower end. Holes are 11 mm (7/16") diameter for 9.5 mm (3/8") drive rivets (typical): 4 places in the post and 3 places in the extension. The existing mounting holes on the STOP sign post are indicated at the lower end.

Street name signs: An isometric view of the extension tube at the top of the existing post, with two stainless steel straps and buckles wrapped around the post and a street name sign bracket clamped to the face. Salvaged street name signs and brackets (typical) project to the side, with a break line showing the sign blades are longer than drawn. Labels: new stainless steel strap and buckle (15 mm x 0.75 mm) (5/8" x 0.03"), tube extension or street light standard, salvaged street name signs and brackets (typical).
notes:
No numbered notes on this sheet.

Callouts: 57 mm (2 1/4") O.D. square steel tube extension, wall thickness of 12 gauge [3 mm (0.118")], galvanized. 11 mm (7/16") diam. holes for 9.5 mm (3/8") drive rivets (typical (TYP.)): 4 places - post, 3 places - extension. Existing mounting holes on STOP sign post. Salvaged street name signs and brackets (typical). New stainless steel strap and buckle (15 mm x 0.75 mm) (5/8" x 0.03"). Tube extension or street light standard.
title: STOP Sign Post Extension for Street Name Signs Installation
summary: Pasadena standard plan S-718 shows a 57 mm (2 1/4 in) galvanized square steel tube extension, 610 mm (24 in) long, inserted into an existing STOP sign post and fastened with 9.5 mm (3/8 in) drive rivets. Salvaged street name signs and brackets are remounted on it using new stainless steel straps and buckles.
